author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists at the Spanish National Cancer Research Centre developed a triple-drug therapy that caused complete and permanent regression of pancreatic tumors in preclinical models. This approach targets KRAS, EGFR, and STAT3 pathways simultaneously, overcoming previous treatment resistance.

Source Article: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2523039122
